status: prospective input-observation protocol for fresh A3 only; frozen before launch
unchanged: Original fixture, all authored values, all numerical/history/save expectations, grader, source/native binary, A130calls/900s and B60calls/600s. Old A/A2 outcomes are immutable and not regraded.
observation_protocol: After the initial click/doubleclick into a numeric field, capture once and inspect visible field/caret/selection before sending Cmd+A/type. Do not infer keyboard focus from an intended label.

After every typeText that edits an A numeric field, take and inspect a screenshot before sending Tab or another focus-changing input. The raw/current value must visibly correspond to the intended field. This separates the typing and focus transition with an observed native frame.

After each Tab used between the five transform fields, capture and inspect the next field selection/current value before issuing its next input. Tab remains the only inter-field navigation route; Enter may submit.

In particular, after correcting retained U1000, require visible U0.5 before Tab, then observe V selected. Continue the same predeclared five values and one final Apply only after the full pre-Apply barrier.

Capture calls count toward the same130call/900s caps. No added retry, corrective drag, fixture edit, numeric tolerance change, case combination or failed-value repair. If any barrier fails or new ambiguity/error occurs, stop unverified and next CUA call only completion_summary; no additional native call or quit.
diagnostic_qualification: A2 has no per-field focus/frame observations and adjacent commands were 6–80ms apart. Installed egui0.35 DragValue processes editing according to focus in a UI pass and focus transfers through framework input. This supports testing event batching as a hypothesis; source reading does not establish the exact A2 cause or rule out a product bug.
native_accessibility_limit: A2 modal fields/buttons were visually present but absent from returned AX. Use actual screenshots without an invented full AX/focused role witness. This protocol does not qualify native modal accessibility.
